function.name: edit_file
function.arguments:
{"path": "config.txt", "content": "# /boot/firmware/config.txt
enable_uart=1
# Enable the 1-wire bus on GPIO4 so DS18B20 probes appear under /sys/bus/w1/devices.
dtoverlay=w1-gpio
"}

text: Fixed: the 1-wire overlay was not loaded. Added dtoverlay=w1-gpio to the firmware config so the w1-gpio bus and w1-therm driver come up on GPIO4; reboot to apply.
